vo: If you shower right before bed,
move: First frame / loop target. The bathroom from above: you (the dot) under the shower, glowing hot, heat shimmering off you, water falling, steam drifting.

vo: you're about an hour too late.
move: A clock grows out of the round basin: bedtime (a moon) at the top, the hour before it shaded.

vo: You don't need a longer shower, just an earlier one.
move: The shower keeps running, same as before; the hands wind back one hour. The clock shrinks back into the basin.

vo: To fall asleep, your body has to cool down.
move: The bathroom morphs into the bedroom piece by piece (tray → bed, mat → duvet, shower head → pillow); you glide slowly onto the pillow. On 'cool down' your glow shrinks and the shimmer stops.

vo: Warm water sends heat out to your hands and feet,
move: Back to the shower, water on, glowing hot. Four small radiators spring up around you and heat flows out to them along dotted paths.

vo: which work like radiators and let it go.
move: The radiators warm and shimmer the heat away; your glow gets smaller.
The clock grows out of the basin again; the minute hand ticks on, sweeping a shaded wedge, while the radiators keep working.

vo: Straight to bed, you're still warm.
move: Quick morph (~0.7 s) into the bedroom, radiators gone; you land on the pillow still glowing hot, shimmer rising.

vo: Researchers at UT Austin pooled 17 studies.
move: Swap: super to the bottom. The stage glides up; the room splits into seventeen tiny showers (rows of 4, 5, 4, 4). Source under the stage.

vo: A warm shower one to two hours before bed
move: Super back to the top. The seventeen pool back into one shower. The clock grows out of the basin: one to two hours before the moon, in amber (the one amber moment).

vo: helped people fall asleep about ten minutes faster.
move: Slow, soft morph into bed (~2 s); you're cool now and your glow goes out: asleep. The bedside table grows into the clock: the minute hand stops ten minutes short of a dashed ghost hand.

vo: See what's keeping you up with the sleep quiz in our bio
move: Back to the bathroom. The mirror swings up off the bottom wall and fills the stage, fogged; 'Take the sleep quiz · See what's keeping you up · Link in bio' gets wiped into the steam line by line, with a drip.
The last frames fade back to frame 0: the shower, you glowing hot.
